items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: And that's Steve Lewis, Charles Bookreis, Juanique, Juanique, that's my brother.

ctx.x: This is a little British subject. It was named Clarence Segari, who was a bass tuba. And that's Steve Lewis, Charles Bookreis, Juanique, Juanique, that's my brother. And this is Luca Trev. Now, that was the whole outset here that went to New York and played at the Roseland.
